The CAD Model Design Intern will support the Entry Systems Modeling project to develop free flight and forced oscillation model design for rapid prototype fabrication.  Develop models in in the form of .igs or .stp, as well as the native CAD format used for the design work

 Undergraduate or Graduate student with a degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering
 Minimum of 2 years’ experience in developing CAD models or 2 semesters of relevant CAD course
